instruction.text: This box has opposite forces affecting it with different strengths. In which direction will it move?

atoms.b: Almost all objects have ((++multiple one)) forces acting on them all the time.
When the forces on an object are ((balanced ++unbalanced)), the object will move.

instruction.text: Drag the arrows to the correct spaces to show the forces acting on this helicopter.

feedback.correct: All objects experience a downward force from gravity, but the upward force from the helicopter is stronger and allows it to fly.

instruction.text: Are the following examples of forces balanced or unbalanced?

feedback.correct: The dog and its owner are pulling on the lead with equal force. This means they aren’t moving
The water is pushing the boat up enough to counter gravity. This is how it is able to float.
The car is moving forwards because the force in this direction is greater. The smaller force slowing it down slightly is called friction.
